title: Scalable Multi-Agent Orchestration and Deterministic Research Workflows
source: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics, 2024
content: Autonomous research systems require structured workflow orchestration to execute complex multi-step information gathering without erratic non-deterministic behavior. Rather than relying entirely on unconstrained stochastic agents, deterministic research orchestrators coordinate specialized pipelines for query decomposition, inverted index retrieval, passage reranking, and provenance tracking. Sub-query expansion breaks high-level research questions into targeted conceptual facets, maximizing recall across specialized document indices. Deduplication filters eliminate redundant evidence across sub-queries, and graph-based extractive summarizers synthesize coherent executive briefs. Grounding every assertion with direct document citations ensures verifiable auditability, making deterministic multi-agent architectures ideal for enterprise compliance, legal discovery, and scientific literature reviews.
